name: Masling
subject: Tool suggestion: Crossword Clue Tutor for vocabulary and word study
message: I maintain Crossword Clue Tutor, a free, account-free hint-first crossword tool. Students use clue wording, answer length, grammar, and trusted crossing letters before revealing an answer, then read a plain-English explanation of why it fits. A classroom-ready Grades 6–12 guide is available at https://crosswordcluetutor.com/guides/crossword-clues-for-vocabulary-learning/ and the solver is at https://crosswordcluetutor.com/solver/. The teacher guide includes a 20-minute routine, differentiation, assessment prompts, privacy notes, and a downloadable reviewed dataset. Full disclosure: I maintain the suggested site.
